en.headline: One illegal guide jailed 54 days after undercover booking
en.dek: Immigration officers and the Travel Industry Council posed as customers and arrested two mainland visitors offering guide and photo services.
body: A mainland visitor was jailed for 54 days on Wednesday after pleading guilty to breaching a condition of stay, following a joint operation against people offering guide and photography services in Hong Kong without permission.

The Immigration Department said it worked with the Travel Industry Council over the past two days after suspects used social media to advertise guide and photo services. Officers posed as customers, made bookings through social platforms, and arrested the two targets when they arrived to provide the services.

The arrested pair were a man and a woman, aged 22 and 43. Both were charged with breaching a condition of stay. One of them pleaded guilty at Sha Tin Magistrates' Courts on Wednesday and was sentenced to 54 days in prison, RTHK reported.

The department said any breach of a condition of stay is an offence, and visitors may not take up employment in Hong Kong, paid or unpaid, without the director of immigration's approval. Employing a person who cannot lawfully be employed is also a serious offence, it said.

zh.headline: 入境處放蛇拘兩名非法導遊 一人判囚54日
zh.dek: 入境處聯同旅監局喬裝顧客，拘捕兩名來港提供導遊及攝影服務的內地旅客，其中一人在沙田裁判法院認罪，判囚54日。
body: 一名內地旅客星期三承認違反逗留條件，被判囚54日。案件源於入境處聯同旅遊業監管局，打擊未獲批准而在港提供導遊及攝影服務的行動。
入境處表示，過去兩日有人透過社交媒體宣傳可來港提供導遊及攝影服務。人員以放蛇方式喬裝顧客，經社交平台查詢及預訂，待兩名目標人物來港提供服務時將他們拘捕。
被捕的是一男一女，年齡分別為22歲及43歲，兩人已被控違反逗留條件。香港電台報道，其中一人星期三在沙田裁判法院承認控罪，被判囚54日。
入境處指出，任何人違反對其有效的逗留條件即屬犯罪；旅客未獲入境處處長批准，無論受薪與否，均不得在港從事僱傭工作。僱用不可合法受僱的人亦屬嚴重罪行。
